observer: Claude (Opus 5.5), 9 Nov 2026: the raw scan (2355 x 3199) blurred 3x3, whole with a 0.05 grid and four crops at 0.02; read for the shell's shape, not against a render
covers: the right wall's aft part looking aft-right: the roof lining and its stud row over SP-3M-2, the bent post with its pressed bead and flared foot, the curved housing with its nested edges, the floor's dark corner box and the bulkhead's corner and low flap
notes: session A (9A33BM2/BM3, not identified; a later sticker in g098-c). Wide lens with strong perspective. CROSS-SESSION matches with the hangar's g096-a (same type, may differ on the individual vehicle): the bent post is g096-a d33 (new.frame.strut_rear_right), the housing g096-a d39/d40, the blue flap g096-a d54. Visible differences: here the roof's row of studs carries an insulated cable on stand-offs (g096-a d11 reads as studs holding the lining, with no cable noted); the first-aid box here lies against the housing with no strap seen over its top (g096-a d42 has a black strap).

details.what: the roof lining: quilted-looking cloth pads, soft and creased, grey-green with brown stains, lighter toward the middle
details.note: no stitching lines are visible; the pads' puffiness shows only in folds

details.what: pale folded seams between the lining's pads, running across the wall
details.size_cue: pads about as long along the wall as the rack's top block

details.what: the pads' lower edge: below it a darker band of lining comes down to the rack's top, a sloped strip between roof and rack
details.note: g098-b d03 is the same strip

details.what: a row of white stand-off insulators on short stems along the lining's lower edge
details.size_cue: each about the size of a fuse holder's cap
details.note: g098-b d04: the same six; g096-a d11 cross-session (see notes)

details.what: a grey cable running from insulator to insulator along the lining's edge and on to the bulkhead's lamp
the rack's top edge under the lining: a row of white trim blocks stepped along it
details.note: cross-session: g096-a d12 (hangar) reads this as a notched strip

details.what: the right wall's post, a wide formed member: straight down from the caged lamp, then bending to run diagonally down and aft
details.size_cue: about as wide as the caged lamp's bezel

details.what: the post's inner edge, turned out where the post bends
a pressed bead down the middle of the post, doubled lower down and following the bend
the post's lower run at the floor: its surface widens into a flared skirt of sheet, scuffed and brown-stained, and meets the floor among rough folds
the curved housing's flat face toward the aisle: light grey, its top and aft outline a smooth arch drawn with a bright rolled rim
details.size_cue: the arch about as tall as the first-aid box is long
details.note: cross-session g096-a d39 (which reads it as a box); here the outline is a clear arch, not square-topped

details.what: the dark olive band beyond that rim, a second outline concentric with it: the curved top of the housing going back to the wall
details.size_cue: the band about as wide as the rim's plate is at the arch's crown
details.note: the first-aid box hides part of it. It is not certain that this outer outline is the tread and not a separate rounded sheet

details.what: a triangular lower corner of the housing's face where it meets the floor, a darker plate closing the arch's foot
a black, sooty wedge or box in the floor corner between the housing and the bulkhead, hex bolts on its sloped face, stained
details.size_cue: about as long as the first-aid box
details.note: not identified. Not g100-c's wedge box d11: that one is blue-grey and on the door's other side, toward the left wall

details.what: a darker strip of raised floor past the black box, running toward the bulkhead, with small studs and a light triangular plate beyond
the blue-grey low flap beside the door's foot, seen at the frame's edge, its hinge along the top
the bulkhead's corner at the right wall: a soft fold running from the blue lamp's side down to the floor, with drips of paint or sealant
the door's frame at the right edge, a rounded upper corner in a dark flange
the first-aid box leaning against the housing's curved band (a short mention, for placing it)
a grey sheet box with a bright top edge across the foreground; its top is a rough guide to where the floor's corner falls, but it hides the floor at the frame's bottom right
